# getDaysInMonth

<link-summary>Returns how many days the month of a date has.</link-summary>

<web-summary>getDaysInMonth() — Returns how many days the month of a date has. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>time</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function getDaysInMonth(date: Date): number;
```

Leap years are handled by the calendar itself, so February is 29 days where it should be. Only the month and the year of the date matter; the day and the time are ignored.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type   | Description                                  |
| :-------- | :----- | :------------------------------------------- |
| `date`    | `Date` | The date to read. It must be a valid `Date`. |

## Returns

`number` — the number of days, from 28 to 31.

## Throws

| Exception                  | Condition                          |
| :------------------------- | :--------------------------------- |
| `IllegalArgumentException` | an argument is not a valid `Date`. |

## Examples

### Counting

```javascript
getDaysInMonth(new Date(2026, 1, 10)); // => 28
```
